title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：website　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 website 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the operator ① built the website that no trainee in the station would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the shift. The ② website, meaning the site itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; a website, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ website in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ website at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A website, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the operator said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the website was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the site. The ⑥ website, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; website, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a site and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ website had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ website of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of recording; website, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ website I remember is the site recorded in the log, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ website, my mother said in 1968, is the only site that improves by being recorded; every website, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a site. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 网站（指机房里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 网站（指那个网站本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the website 建这一个网站
D. n. 网站（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 网站之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的网站之事）
F. n. 网站（指运行日志里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 网站、发声（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 发声（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the website that no trainee in the station would have recorded
The website, meaning the site itself and not the switch
the website at the far screen
the website was the whole of the matter
the website had become a line in a log
The website of the whole thing
A website, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: build the website 意为“建这一个网站”，1959 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯记载的一个网站做了一遍。
website 意为“网站”，指那个网站本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记载。
website 意为“网站”，指机房里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
website 意为“网站”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
website 意为“网站、发声”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个发声就是那件事的全部。
website 意为“发声”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个网站，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
website 意为“网站”，指运行日志里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1964 年这一个成了运行日志里的一行。
website 意为“网站之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的网站之事是一处机房和三个班次的记载。
website 意为“网站”，我记得的是运行日志里记载过的那一个，1966 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一个。
website 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，网站是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的网站。
